step_1_receptor_engagement.co_expression_verdict: PASS — both receptors expressed in aged MF-I and MF-II (pc>=0.10, me>0.5)
step_1_receptor_engagement.implied_icd_spacing_note: ERBB4 ICD=633 aa (long flexible juxtamembrane + kinase) vs INSR ICD=403 aa (shorter). The 60 Å rigid helix forces the two ICDs into a fixed orientation. ERBB4's longer juxtamembrane region (676-717) provides conformational flexibility that may partially compensate, but the INSR ICD is substantially shorter — the kinase domains (ERBB4 718-985 vs INSR 1023-1298) will be offset by ~300 aa of ICD length difference, creating an asymmetric transphosphorylation geometry.

step_2_structural_geometry.structural_evidence: Both receptors have solved ECD and kinase domain structures. ERBB4 ECD (2AHX) shows the typical ErbB furin-like domain architecture. INSR ECD (3BU3) shows the (αβ)₂ disulfide-linked dimer. The large ECD asymmetry (626 vs 929 aa) means the rigid 60 Å linker will position the INSR ICD substantially further from the membrane plane than the ERBB4 ICD, creating a tilted transphosphorylation geometry.

transphosphorylation_adaptors.GRB2: Recruited to ERBB4 pY sites (Y1056, Y1188, Y1242) via SH2 domain. Also binds INSR via IRS1/2 docking. Under forced proximity, INSR kinase can transphosphorylate ERBB4 at GRB2-docking sites, and ERBB4 kinase can transphosphorylate INSR at IRS-docking sites — creating a reinforced GRB2-SOS-RAS-MAPK signal.
transphosphorylation_adaptors.SHC1: Binds ERBB4 pY sites directly (Y1188, Y1242). Also recruited by INSR via IRS1/2. Transphosphorylation between the two kinases creates additional SHC-docking phosphotyrosines on both receptors.
transphosphorylation_adaptors.IRS1: Classical INSR substrate — INSR phosphorylates IRS1 at multiple YXXM motifs that recruit PI3K. Under forced proximity, ERBB4 kinase can also phosphorylate IRS1 at INSR-docking sites, amplifying IRS1-mediated signaling.
transphosphorylation_adaptors.IRS2: Similar to IRS1 — INSR substrate that can be transphosphorylated by ERBB4 kinase under forced co-clustering.
transphosphorylation_adaptors.PIK3R1: p85 regulatory subunit of PI3K. Recruited to pYXXM motifs on IRS1/IRS2 (activated by INSR) and to ERBB4 pY sites (CYT-1 isoform has Y1056 in YXXM context). Transphosphorylation amplifies PI3K docking sites on both receptors.
transphosphorylation_adaptors.GAB1: Scaffold that binds PI3K, SHP2, and GRB2. Recruited to ERBB4 via GRB2. Under forced proximity, INSR kinase can also phosphorylate GAB1, amplifying PI3K-AKT and MAPK signaling.
transphosphorylation_adaptors.PTPN11: SHP2 phosphatase — binds ERBB4 pY sites and IRS1/2. Transphosphorylation creates additional PTPN11 docking sites, promoting sustained MAPK signaling.
transphosphorylation_adaptors.FRS2: Classical FGFR/RTK adaptor. Binds INSR (confirmed by BioGRID biochemical activity, PMID:10650943). Under forced proximity, ERBB4 kinase can transphosphorylate FRS2 at its GRB2-docking sites, coupling to MAPK.

cis_adaptors.STAT5A: Binds ERBB4 ICD directly (BioGRID affinity capture, PMID:15534001, PMID:16729043). Also binds INSR (PMID:12456798). These are cis interactions that occur in natural signaling and are not uniquely amplified by forced proximity.
cis_adaptors.STAT5B: Binds INSR (PMID:12456798). Cis interaction — not uniquely biased by forced proximity.
cis_adaptors.CBL: E3 ubiquitin ligase that binds ERBB4 pY sites (BioGRID, PMID:25140053). Involved in receptor downregulation — a cis event.
cis_adaptors.NCK1: Binds ERBB4 (BioGRID, PMID:16729043). Adaptor for actin reorganization — cis interaction.

excluded_adaptors.PLCG1: PLCγ1 requires specific docking geometry that spans both kinase domains in a precise orientation. The 60 Å rigid helix with 303 aa ECD asymmetry creates a tilted ICD interface that prevents PLCγ from bridging the two receptors. This is the same exclusion mechanism seen in H2F (HER2+FGFR1) where PLCγ is sterically blocked.
excluded_adaptors.PLCG2: Same steric exclusion as PLCG1 — requires precise spatial arrangement of docking phosphotyrosines that the asymmetric ERBB4-INSR geometry cannot provide.

excluded_pathways: PLCγ-Ca²⁺-PKC (PLCG1/2 sterically excluded by asymmetric ICD geometry)
JAK-STAT (STAT5A/B are cis-only, not amplified by transphosphorylation)

gene_direction_rationale.predicted_up_rationale: MAPK/ERK and PI3K-AKT-mTOR activation downstream of GRB2-SHC1-IRS1-PIK3R1 signaling drives expression of muscle structural and contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN, MYL6, TPM2) that are young-enriched (P2_up atlas markers). NOTCH3 is a MuSC quiescence/maintenance marker upregulated by AKT signaling. IGFBP7 and TIMP3 are extracellular matrix regulators that decline with age and are restored by AKT signaling. DSTN, MAFB, FMN1 are young-enriched P2_up markers. CLIC4 and PPP1R14A are downstream of SRF/MRTF signaling activated by MAPK.
gene_direction_rationale.predicted_down_rationale: MAPK/ERK signaling suppresses IEG/AP-1 transcription factors (EGR1, FOS, JUN) that are chronically elevated in aged muscle (P1_up markers). TXNIP (oxidative stress sensor), IL32 (inflammatory cytokine), and MYF5 (myogenic factor) are all aged-enriched markers suppressed by AKT-mediated FOXO exclusion from the nucleus. MYH9 (non-muscle myosin IIA), TTN (titin), PRUNE2, ASB5, NEB are structural genes whose aged-elevated expression reflects denervation/reinnervation stress — suppressed by restored MAPK/AKT signaling. DNAJA4 (chaperone), ETS2 (transcription factor), FABP5 (lipid chaperone) are all P1_up aged markers.

calibration_alignment.win_pattern_notes: Predicted_up contains muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN, MYL6, TPM2) matching the Win 1-3 pattern. Predicted_down contains IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and aged markers (OTUD1, TXNIP, IL32, MYF5, MYH9) matching the Win 1-3 pattern. This is consistent with the ERBB4+FGFR1/2/4 wins where GRB2-SHC1-FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1 transphosphorylation drove the same gene direction pattern.
calibration_alignment.fail_pattern_notes: Unlike Fail 1 (TNFR1+IL6R) which had broken adaptor coverage and put IEGs in predicted_up, this candidate has strong transphosphorylation adaptor coverage (GRB2, SHC1, IRS1, IRS2, PIK3R1, GAB1, PTPN11, FRS2) and correctly places IEGs in predicted_down.

mechanism_narrative: ERBB4-INSR forced proximity via a 60 Å rigid helix linker creates asymmetric transphosphorylation where ERBB4 kinase phosphorylates INSR substrates (IRS1, IRS2, FRS2) and INSR kinase phosphorylates ERBB4 docking sites (GRB2, SHC1, GAB1). This amplifies GRB2-SOS-RAS-MAPK and IRS1-PIK3R1-AKT signaling while sterically excluding PLCγ docking. The biased output shifts aged muscle toward a young transcriptional phenotype by upregulating contractile structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) and suppressing IEG/AP-1 inflammatory programs (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and aged stress markers (TXNIP, IL32).
